settings.logoAlt: Psalm 23 Transportation logo: a bronze and forest-green heavy-duty flatbed truck in a puzzle pattern

hero.intro: Dependable flatbed transportation for equipment, materials, and cleanup jobs. Tell us what needs moving, where it is headed, and when you need it there, and we will help you plan the next step.
hero.ribbon: RELIABLE FLATBED TRANSPORT FOR LOCAL AND LONGER-DISTANCE JOBS.

services.intro: We keep the process simple: share the job details, route, and timing, and we will confirm the best next step, availability, and pricing.

cards.title: Equipment & materials
cards.description: Need tools, supplies, building materials, or other bulky items moved? Tell us the size, approximate weight, and pickup details so we can assess the job.

cards.title: Scrap, debris & property cleanup
cards.description: From scrap metal to cleanup runs, we can help transport items that need collecting and delivering to the right destination.

cards.title: Local & longer-distance hauling
cards.description: Whether the job is nearby or farther out, share the pickup point, destination, and preferred timing and we will let you know what is possible.

story.paragraph1: Psalm 23 Transportation is a family-owned business founded by Isabella, her boyfriend, and her dad. Their Christian faith shapes the way they work: with honesty, care, and a commitment to serving people well.
story.paragraph2: Our truck logo reflects the work we do every day: showing up prepared, communicating clearly, and carrying each job through from pickup to delivery. We aim to be dependable, respectful, and straightforward in every interaction.
story.verse: “The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

quote.intro: Tell us what needs transporting, where it should be collected, and where it needs to go. We will review the details and get back to you about availability and a quote.
quote.smallNote: Prefer a quick conversation? Call, text, or email us directly.
quote.loadPlaceholder: Describe the items, estimated size or weight, and any special details
quote.dateLabel: When do you need it moved? (optional)
quote.disclaimer: Opens a message in your texting app. Please review and send it yourself; your request is not sent automatically.
